name: Gaussian-to-Intersect Mapping and Sorting
aliases: Tile-Based Gaussian Visibility Culling and Sorting
definition: A preprocessing pipeline for 2D Gaussian rasterization that maps 3D Gaussian projections to tile-based intersection IDs, sorts them for depth ordering, and computes tile bins to enable efficient tile-based rendering.
summary: Gaussian-to-Intersect Mapping and Sorting is a non-differentiable CUDA preprocessing pipeline that culls invisible Gaussians, maps 3D projections to tile-based intersection IDs, and sorts them for efficient depth-ordered rendering.
